data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek words 'homos' meaning 'same' and 'agape' meaning 'love'. Homovec signifies 'loving God' or 'having the same love for God'. The name Homovec carries the meaning “Loving God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Homovec usually hope their child will grow to embody loving god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
